report.source_text: The pathological specimens of the cerebral tumour contained a mixture of adenocarcinoma-like area with atypical cells forming small ducts and nests and an area with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli (figure 2A). On immunohistochemical analysis showed that CK AE1/3, CK7 and synaptophysin were diffusely positive in all regions (figure 2B). In addition, p40, Napsin A and CK20 showed negative results. Based on the above findings, the pathologist diagnosed the lesion as a mixture of adenocarcinoma and LCNEC.

report.source_text: Based on the NGS results (Oncomine Comprehensive Assay, Thermo Fisher Scientific), the tumour had two major somatic mutations, BRAF V600E and TP53 H179Q mutation. TP53 H179 is known as a missense mutation that worsens prognosis.1 The mutation allele frequency (MAF) of BRAF was 0.483 and that of TP53 was 0.916. The MAF values showed that this mutation in TP53 caused mutations in both alleles of DNA. On the other hand, BRAF V600E mutation is known to cause deletion of one allele, loss of heterozygosity, and the BRAF MAF value close to 0.5 indicated that most of the cells had the BRAF V600E mutation.

clinician.trajectory_summary: A 57-year-old woman with a history of smoking presented with headache, vomiting, and occasional balance loss. Initial imaging revealed a 45 mm cystic mass in the right cerebellum, a tumor in the right pulmonary hilum, and mediastinal lymphadenopathies. The cerebral tumor was surgically resected, and its pathology confirmed a mixture of adenocarcinoma and large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC), characterized by specific immunohistochemical markers (CK AE1/3, CK7, synaptophysin, TTF-1, Chromogranin A, CD56). Molecular analysis of the cerebral tumor detected BRAF V600E and TP53 H179Q mutations, with immunostaining confirming BRAF V600E positivity in both adenocarcinoma and LCNEC components. Endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration (EBUS-TBNA) of the mediastinal lymph nodes showed atypical cells consistent with LCNEC, without adenocarcinoma-like cells.
